checklist-electrical-room.docx.title: Electrical room checklist
checklist-electrical-room.docx.intro: Contoso Inspections, fictional demo content. Severity words: Info, Minor, Major, Critical.
items: No cables cross a walkway. A cable across a walkway is Critical.
Panel covers are fitted. A missing cover is Major.
No storage within one metre of the panels.
Test stickers on portable equipment are in date. An expired sticker is Minor.

checklist-fire-doors.docx.title: Fire door checklist
checklist-fire-doors.docx.intro: Contoso Inspections, fictional demo content. Severity words: Info, Minor, Major, Critical.
items: Door closes fully on its own from any open angle.
Seals and smoke strips are present and undamaged.
Nothing holds the door open. A wedge is a Major finding.
Door is not blocked on either side. A blocked escape route is Critical.
Signage 'Fire door keep shut' is visible.

checklist-housekeeping.docx.title: Housekeeping checklist
checklist-housekeeping.docx.intro: Contoso Inspections, fictional demo content. Severity words: Info, Minor, Major, Critical.
items: Aisles are clear and at least 1.2 metres wide.
Waste is in bins and bins are not overflowing.
Spills are cleaned or signed. A fresh unsigned spill is Minor.
Shelves are stable and heavy items are low.
Exits are free of boxes. Blocked exits are Major.
